leader.name: Roronoa Zoro & Sanji
leader.text: [DON!! x1][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] You may return 1 of your Characters with a cost of 2 or more to the owner's hand: Set up to 1 of your Characters with 7000 power or less as active.

cards.name: Kuina
cards.text: [Activate:Main] You may rest this Character: Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less. [Trigger] Play this card.

cards.name: Dracule Mihawk
subTypes: The Seven Warlords of the Sea Muggy Kingdom
cards.text: [On Play] If you have 2 or less Characters, play up to 1 [Muggy Kingdom] type or "Slash" attribute Character card with a cost of 4 or less other than [Dracule Mihawk] from your hand rested.

cards.name: Yosaku & Johnny
cards.text: [DON!! x1][When Attacking] Choose one: • Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less. • K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 2 or less.

cards.name: Rika
cards.text: [On Play] (2) (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.): If your opponent has 3 or more Life cards, set up to 1 of your "Slash" attribute Characters with a cost of 4 or less as active.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro
cards.text: [DON!! x1][When Attacking] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less.

cards.name: Emporio.Ivankov
cards.text: [On Play] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck and play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 2. Then, place the rest at the top or bottom of your deck. [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] Draw 1 card if you have 6 or less cards in your hand.

cards.name: Sanji
cards.text: [DON!! x1][When Attacking] If you have 5 or less cards in your hand, this Character gains +2000 power until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Charlotte Pudding
cards.text: [Activate:Main] Return this Character to the owner's hand.

cards.name: Zeff
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck and place them at the top or bottom of the deck in any order. [When Attacking] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck and play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 2 rested. Then, place the rest at the top or bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Duval
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.) [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck and place them at the top or bottom of the deck in any order.

cards.name: Lion Strike
cards.text: [Main] / [Counter] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards with a cost of 4 or less. [Trigger] Activate this card's [Main] effect.

cards.name: Plastic Surgery Shot
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, reveal 1 card from the top of your deck, play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 2, and place the rest at the top or bottom of your deck.
